issues: Appended Chinese-language section contradicts the main appraisal: it asserts S2 and S3 full texts were preserved and reports full-text-level facts (database versions, sample sizes, sensitivity analyses), while the brief requires recording them as abstract-level until full text preserved and the Engl
Duplicate/alternate appraisal produces conflicting access-level records and different certainty bodies (B1-B4 vs B1-B3), so the delivery is not a single consolidated answer.
The Chinese section appears to treat abstract-level sources as full text, violating the mustNotDo requirement not to call the two model abstracts full text.
judge.rationale: Main English appraisal answers both halves: identifies models and leaves MIMIC-IV cohort overlap unresolved, with required fields named. However the appended Chinese section contradicts it on source access level, reporting S2/S3 as preserved full text and using full-text-level facts; this breaks evidence-handling and internal consistency. Safety framing is clean: no treatment recommendation, and risk statements keep their evidence level.
